_comment: OpenRouter model ids (DECISIONS #1, #3). Top level = dev profile (DeepSeek v4.1 Flash). MODEL_PROFILE=bench switches worker/judge/lesson writer to GPT-6 Luna for benchmark + demo. WORKER_MODEL env overrides worker last.

request_options._comment: Chat request options (DECISIONS #11, docs/SMOKE.md). default applies to every chat model; models[<id>] overrides. reasoning_effort null = omit reasoning. provider_order pins a provider (allow_fallbacks false); otherwise auto_pin_provider pins to the first responding provider for prompt-cache hits. provider.require_parameters is always sent.
